project_overview.name: Автомойка AAA (Car Wash AAA)
project_overview.description: Award-worthy, single-page landing for a premium local car wash in Saint Petersburg.
project_overview.vibe: Energetic Premium, Dark Mode, High Contrast, Automotive Luxury

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-bold
scales.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#737373]

typography.instructions: ALL fonts MUST support Cyrillic. Ensure Unbounded and Manrope are loaded from Google Fonts in index.html or global css. Do NOT use Inter for headings.

motion_and_interactions.global: Implement @studio-freight/lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.reveals: Use framer-motion for line-by-line text reveals on scroll (y: 100% -> 0%, clip-path mask).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons should have a scale up effect (scale: 1.05) and a subtle box-shadow glow using the accent color.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Hero image and section background images should have a subtle parallax effect on scroll (y: -10% to 10%).

header.layout: Fixed top, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#050505]/70 border-b border-white/5). z-50.
header.elements: Logo (Text: AAA), Desktop Nav Links, Primary CTA Button 'Записаться'.

hero.layout: min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden
hero.visuals: Background image of wet dark sports car. MUST have overlay: bg-black/50 to bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] to-transparent.
hero.content: Kinetic typography headline. Staggered reveal. Primary CTA 'ЗАПИСАТЬСЯ НА МОЙКУ' opening booking form.

marquee.layout: Full width, py-8 border-y border-white/5 overflow-hidden flex whitespace-nowrap
marquee.content: Continuously scrolling text of services (e.g., 'БЕСКОНТАКТНАЯ МОЙКА • ХИМЧИСТКА...'). Use framer-motion or CSS infinite scroll. Font: Unbounded, text-transparent with stroke-white/20.

manifesto_trust.layout: Bento grid (Tetris layout mode). CSS Grid, md:grid-cols-3 gap-6.
manifesto_trust.content: 01 Без предоплаты, 02 Оплата после результата, 03 Личная проверка. Use large numbers, high contrast.
manifesto_trust.style: Cards with bg-[#121212], border border-white/5, p-8 rounded-2xl. Hover effect: border-[#FF3E15]/50.

services_interactive.layout: Vertical list layout with large typographic items.
services_interactive.content: 6 services. On desktop, hovering a list item should fade in/reveal a specific image related to the service on the side, or attached to the cursor.
services_interactive.style: List item: text-3xl md:text-5xl Unbounded, text-white/50 hover:text-white transition-colors py-6 border-b border-white/10.

promo_banner.layout: Full width container inside px-4. Gradient/accent background.
promo_banner.style: bg-[#FF3E15] text-[#050505] rounded-3xl p-12 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between overflow-hidden relative.
promo_banner.content: Title: 'ОЧИСТКА КУЗОВА ГЛИНОЙ'. Price: '1500₽'. Tag: '+ ПОДАРОК 300₽'. CTA button.

reviews.content: Highlight Google Rating 4.5. Testimonials with stars (Phosphor Icons).

booking_and_contacts.layout: Two columns: Form on left, Contacts on right.
booking_and_contacts.form: Customized Shadcn UI inputs. Dark mode styled (bg-transparent, border-white/20). Fields: Name, Phone, Service, Date. Submission triggers WhatsApp URL.
booking_and_contacts.contacts: Address (Московский пр., 191А), Google Map (grayscale/dark mode iframe or placeholder image), Phone number, Hours.

images.description: Front of black car with water droplets, dramatic lighting. Use with black/50 overlay.
Red power tool polishing a dark car. Energetic.
Close up of clean car wheel.
Red and black car interior detailing.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react. Sharp, technical aesthetic.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays that have text. Always use backdrop-blur and a tint (e.g. bg-[#050505]/80).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for testing.
Do not use basic transition-all. Be specific: transition-transform, transition-colors.
Do not center-align everything. Use Left alignment for text blocks and grids to maintain a Swiss layout feel.
Ensure Shadcn UI components are restyled to fit the Dark Energetic theme. Strip out standard white backgrounds and Vercel-like borders.
Add 'dark' class to html or body to ensure tailwind dark mode utilities are active by default.
Implement the WhatsApp booking logic: const url = `https://wa.me/YOUR_NUMBER?text=...`; window.open(url, '_blank').
